newsitem.title: USA: Gigante, charged in murder, pleads not guilty.
newsitem.headline: Gigante, charged in murder, pleads not guilty.

text.p: Trembling and muttering to himself, Vincent "Chin" Gigante, said to be the nation's most powerful mob boss, pleaded not guilty on Friday to murder and racketeering charges.
The plea was entered for him by his new defence lawyer, James LaRossa, before Brooklyn Federal Judge Eugene Nickerson.
"He pleads not guilty, your honour," the lawyer said.

Gigante, who was found competent to stand trial last month after what the judge ruled was a 30-year history of faking psychiatric problems, staggered into the packed courtroom shortly after 3 p.m. He was accompanied by his cardiologist, Dr. Bernard Wechsler, who held onto Gigante with one arm and carried the traditional black doctor's bag in the other.
Gigante was charged with eight murders, two conspiracies and a number of other related racketeering crimes.

The 68-year-old reputed crime boss of the Genovese crime family, known for wearing his bathrobe and slippers around his New York neighbourhood wore a blue jacket, white sports shirt, black sweat pants, white socks and black unpolished shoes.
He looked dishevelled and unkempt, sporting several days growth of beard.
A March 17 trial date was set. Gigante is scheduled to appear on Oct. 4 for a pretrial hearing.
"I can tell you that getting Mr. Gigante here is an incredible task," LaRossa told the judge.

During the 12-minute arraignment, Gigante was observed fidgiting in his seat, scratching his head nervously, wiping his mouth and muttering to himself. At one point, his body began shaking and he rubbed his hand over his heart.
At that point, Gigante's doctor, seated just behind him, gently patted the patient on the shoulder.
His lawyer declined to answer any questions.
"Obviously, it was a difficult day for Vincent Gigante," LaRossa said. "You observed him, I'm sure. You saw what he looked like."
Gigante has been free on $1 million bail that is secured by property put up by his children.
